map.居家跌倒环境风险总分 = 室内照明 + 地面防滑 + 地面障碍物 + 地毯垫子: Total home fall environment risk = indoor lighting + floor anti-slip + floor obstacles + carpets and mats + bathroom safety + furniture stability + stairs and steps + bed and chair height (0 to 3 points each, 24 in total); 3 points or below is low risk, 4 to 10 is medium risk, 11 and above is high risk; items with high scores are retrofitted one by one.
map.老年人室内环境防跌倒风险评估（8项检查清单）: Indoor environment fall prevention risk assessment for older adults (8-item checklist)
map.充足明亮无暗区 (0分): Ample and bright with no dark areas (0 points)
map.部分区域偏暗 (2分): Some areas are rather dark (2 points)
map.杂物堆积/电线横穿 (3分): Clutter piled up / cables crossing (3 points)
map.有扶手+防滑垫 (0分): Has grab bars and anti-slip mat (0 points)
map.有扶手或防滑垫 (2分): Has grab bars or anti-slip mat (2 points)
map.多处不稳/带轮无锁 (3分): Many unstable / casters without locks (3 points)
map.有扶手+照明好/无楼梯 (0分): Has grab bars and good lighting / no stairs (0 points)
map.扶手不全/照明不足 (2分): Incomplete grab bars / insufficient lighting (2 points)
map.偏高或偏低 (2分): A little high or low (2 points)
map.📚 深度解析：防跌倒风险评估（室内环境问卷）: In-Depth Analysis: Fall Prevention Risk Assessment (indoor environment questionnaire)
map.居家适老化改造前，按 8 项环境要素评估跌倒风险，定位需整改点。: Before age-friendly home renovation, fall risk is assessed on 8 environmental elements to locate the points needing rectification.
map.照明、地面防滑、障碍物、卫生间、家具与楼梯等逐项打分，总分定风险级。: Lighting, floor anti-slip, obstacles, bathroom, furniture and stairs are scored item by item, and the total sets the risk level.
map.重点项（≥2）自动生成整改建议（如加装扶手、铺设防滑垫）。: Key items (>=2) automatically generate rectification suggestions (such as adding grab bars and laying anti-slip mats).
map.环境风险评分 = 0 / 24 → 『低风险』，保持现有安全措施即可。: Environment risk score = 0 / 24 -> 'low risk'; keeping the existing safety measures is enough.
map.算例：多项存在问题（合计 16）: Worked example: several items have problems (total 16)
map.总分 = 16 > 10 → 『高风险』，需立即改造（如卫生间加扶手、地面防滑、: Total = 16 > 10 -> 'high risk'; immediate renovation is needed (such as adding bathroom grab bars, floor anti-slip and clearing walkways), and professional on-site assessment is recommended.
map.跌倒风险分几级？: How many levels of fall risk are there?
map.按 8 项环境求和（满分 24）：≤3 低、≤10 中、>10 高。高风险须立即: Sum the 8 environmental items (24 in total): <=3 low, <=10 medium, >10 high. High risk requires immediate age-friendly renovation and consideration of a professional assessment.
map.哪些整改最划算？: Which rectifications give the best value?
map.卫生间扶手+防滑垫、通道杂物清理、夜灯照明是低成本高收益的优先项；楼梯/高差处加: Bathroom grab bars and anti-slip mats, clearing walkway clutter, and night lighting are low-cost high-benefit priorities; adding grab bars and step lights at stairs and level changes significantly reduces the probability of fall injury.
